2609.20045.title: Correct Now, Insufficient Later: Auditing Update Sufficiency in Context Compression
2609.20045.paper_summary: A memory can answer a current query correctly while discarding distinctions required by a later update. We investigate this failure with a paired-history audit: two histories have the same current answer, receive a shared future update, and require different subsequent answers. A pilot evaluates 24 history pairs across six synthetic mechanisms, 12 memory conditions, two repeats, and two model backends. A deterministic frontier selector obtains strict reveal accuracy of 96/96 on DeepSeek and 82/96 on GLM; a structured writer obtains 62 successes with one unresolved outcome and 56/96. The configured four-outcome joint contrast has finite-sample identification intervals of [0.521, 0.542] and [0.292, 0.313], not confidence intervals. A record-level audit distinguishes retained-state adequacy, response delivery, and answer-schema compliance without changing those original scores. It finds 26 and 25 well-formed but semantically wrong structured reveal memories, while all 14 GLM frontier reveal failures contain correct values in the wrong wrapper. Tombstone removal produces 16/16 exact replay failures in the targeted mechanism. Identifier renaming then exposes a separate flaw: original frontier late-reference adequacy falls from 8/8 to 94/320 transformed instances. We provide and test a label-equivariant repair, but it preserves only 2/8 original late-reference answers: eliminating a naming shortcut does not solve unknown future relevance. These results support a scoped evaluation methodology and reproducible failure analysis, not general superiority of the repaired algorithm. Paid pilot evidence, retrospective diagnostics, and new offline tests are reported separately; no independent held-out or natural-task validation is claimed.
2609.20045.paper_summary_zh: 記憶可以正確回答當前查詢，同時丟棄後續更新所需的區別。我們通過配對歷史審計來調查這一失敗：兩個歷史擁有相同的當前答案，接收共享的未來更新，並需要不同的後續答案。一個試點在六種合成機制、12種記憶條件、兩次重複和兩個模型後端中評估了24對歷史。確定性邊界選擇器在DeepSeek上獲得了96/96的嚴格揭示準確率，在GLM上為82/96；結構化寫入者獲得了62次成功，並有一個未解決的結果和56/96的結果。配置的四結果聯合對比具有有限樣本識別區間[0.521, 0.542]和[0.292, 0.313]，而不是置信區間。記錄級別的審計區分保留狀態的充分性、響應交付和答案架構的合規性，而不改變這些原始分數。它發現26個結構化揭示記憶是格式良好但語義錯誤的，25個；而所有14個GLM邊界揭示失敗都包含錯誤包裝中的正確值。墓碑移除在目標機制中產生了16/16的精確重播失敗。識別符重命名隨後揭示了一個單獨的缺陷：原始邊界的晚期參考充分性從8/8下降到94/320的轉換實例。我們提供並測試了一種標籤等變修復，但它僅保留了2/8的原始晚期參考答案：消除命名捷徑並不能解決未知的未來相關性。這些結果支持了一種範疇評估方法論和可重複的失敗分析，而不是修復算法的一般優越性。付費試點證據、回顧性診斷和新的離線測試將分別報告；不聲稱有獨立的保留或自然任務驗證。
